## GET /scan
Scans an image and extracts text and metadata.

### Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `url` | string | Yes | The URL of the image to be scanned. |
| `format` | string | No | The desired output format (e.g., "json", "xml"). Defaults to "json". |

### Response

```json
{
  "text": "This is sample text extracted from the image.",
  "metadata": {
    "width": 800,
    "height": 600,
    "format": "jpeg",
    "size": 123456,
    "orientation": "landscape",
    "exif": {
      "make": "Canon",
      "model": "EOS 5D Mark III",
      "exposureTime": "1/125",
      "fNumber": "f/8.0",
      "iso": 400,
      "dateTime": "2023-04-01T12:34:56"
    }
  }
}
```

### Error Codes

| Status Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 400 | Bad Request (e.g., missing required parameters) |
| 404 | Image not found |
| 500 | Internal Server Error |
